Purpose
-------
Replace the template description in `.github/repository.settings.yml` with a repository-specific description.

Prerequisites
-------------
- Local clone with `origin` set and push access.
- `git` available. PowerShell recommended on Windows.

Dry-run (preview)
-----------------
```powershell
git fetch origin --prune
if (-Not (Test-Path .github\repository.settings.yml)) { Write-Host "No .github/repository.settings.yml found."; exit }
$current = Get-Content .github\repository.settings.yml | Where-Object { $_ -match '^description:' }
Write-Host "Current description:"; $current

# Build default description from remote
$url = git config --get remote.origin.url
if ($url -match '[:/](.+?)/(.+?)(\.git)?$') { $owner=$matches[1]; $name=$matches[2] } else { $owner='unknown'; $name=(Get-Item -Path .).Name }
$generated = "WinCC OA APM package: $owner/$name"
Write-Host "Proposed description:"; "description: \"$generated\""

# To apply, run the Apply step below.
```

Apply (safe, non-destructive)
-----------------------------
This replaces the `description:` line (if present) or adds it if missing.

```powershell
# Optionally provide DESCRIPTION environment variable to override default
if ($env:DESCRIPTION) { $desc = $env:DESCRIPTION } else {
  $url = git config --get remote.origin.url
  if ($url -match '[:/](.+?)/(.+?)(\.git)?$') { $owner=$matches[1]; $name=$matches[2] } else { $owner='unknown'; $name=(Get-Item -Path .).Name }
  $desc = "WinCC OA APM package: $owner/$name"
}

if (-Not (Test-Path .github\repository.settings.yml)) {
  Write-Host "Creating .github/repository.settings.yml with description..."
  @"
# Repository settings used by org automation and publishing tools
description: "$desc"
default_branch: main
"@ | Out-File -Encoding utf8 .github\repository.settings.yml
} else {
  $file = Get-Content .github\repository.settings.yml
  if ($file -match '^description:') {
    $new = $file -replace '^description:.*', "description: \"$desc\""
  } else {
    $new = @()
    $new += "description: \"$desc\""
    $new += $file
    $new = $new -join "`n"
  }
  $new | Out-File -Encoding utf8 .github\repository.settings.yml
}

git add .github/repository.settings.yml
git commit -m "chore: update repository description to repo-specific value" || Write-Host "No changes to commit"
git push origin HEAD
```

Notes
-----
- To provide a custom description without editing the script, set an environment variable before running:

```powershell
$env:DESCRIPTION = 'My custom repository description'
.\path\to\script.ps1
```

 - If your repo uses a primary branch other than `main`, adjust `default_branch` accordingly.
